name:
Bella Sara
L'aventure du cheval magique
formal_name:
Bella Sara
L'aventure du cheval magique
description:
For the first time on
Nintendo 3DS™, discover the world
fascinating by Bella Sara. Imagine and
create your own magical horse,
come to the aid of your friends,
complete many quests and
complete all the challenges to earn
new accessories and make your
fabulous mount a unique horse and
legendary.
